name: mech-8-sticky-tile-room
source: mech-8-sticky-tile Test Level: 3-tile sticky shortcut (SSS) in a wall divider, orb on the far side, return orb on the long-way bottom passage; leaving each sticky tile takes two inputs (first strains in place, second steps off) and the tiles stay reusable. Teaching moment: the shortcut costs moves rather than distance — a player who presses once to leave a sticky tile is still straining on it, and the retry teaches the two-input cost. The patroller that would cross the shortcut at full speed is synergy mech 31, deferred to its own feature (blocked-by: 31).
